name: Francesco Maria Colosimo
bioAdditions: A Francesco Colosimo was buried at San Mango on 20 October 1692 (S1), matching the tree's death date. His son Giovanni Antonio was baptized in 1679 (Book 2, img 26 no. 11) as son of Francesco and Giustina Berardello.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).

sources.citation: San Mango d'Aquino (CZ), parish of San Tommaso d'Aquino, Morti 1687-1713 (Book 3), image 134, p. 223, no. 11; volunteer index 'Indici Morti - San Mango D'Aquino - Chiese di San Tommaso 1653-1713, 1747-1767, 1811-1942.xlsx' (ItalianParishRecords.org, San Mango d'Aquino page; indexers incl. D. Lupia and J. Bifano/Epifano), sheet '1687-1713'.
